overview.headline: How Wright brothers tested and fixed early lift predictions

keyPoints.point: Wright brothers designed gliders and powered aircraft while studying lift needs
keyPoints.quote: Between 1900 and 1905, the Wright brothers designed and built three unpowered gliders and three powered aircraft.

keyPoints.point: Lift generated by an object depends on air properties with velocity and surface area
keyPoints.quote: The amount of lift generated by an object depends on a number of factors

keyPoints.point: Smeaton coefficient links velocity and wing area to lift prediction
keyPoints.quote: where L is the lift, k is the Smeaton coefficient, V is the velocity, A is the wing area, and cl is the lift coefficient.

keyPoints.point: The brothers doubted Smeaton coefficient value after flight data mismatch
keyPoints.quote: the brothers began to doubt the .005 value for the Smeaton coefficient
